groups.title: 1 · Artwork edge
groups.heading: A picture on the page.
groups.description: Compare the current borderless artwork with two restrained treatments. All three keep the same image, crop and caption. These samples remain in Light so the edge is easy to compare.
variants: A · A fine warm keyline — recommended
checks: A adds a single thin warm edge. B adds a 6px paper surround.
Neither changes the artwork or adds raised shadows, rounded corners or motion.
Look at the full opening as well as the image edge.

groups.title: 2 · Reading light
groups.heading: The same home, after dusk.
groups.description: Compare the current Light-only homepage with an Appearance icon or an icon plus label. A and B initially show Dark so you can judge the palette; open Appearance to try Light or System. On narrow screens, Appearance lives inside the menu. The eventual default would follow System.
checks: Try Light, Dark and System in the preview; artwork colours stay intact.
Your theme choice is remembered only within these appearance mockups. It does not change the homepage or count as design approval.
On phones, open the menu to find Appearance.
Use the approval button below to record your preferred control.
